dedupe_keys.name: sachet national disaster alert feed india common alerting protocol warnings from imd cwc and state disaster authorities as an all india rss feed with cap xml per alert

description: SACHET is India's national disaster alert portal, which gathers early warnings from the agencies that issue them and republishes them in the Common Alerting Protocol (CAP), the international standard for machine-readable alerts. It is run by the National Disaster Management Authority (NDMA) as a CAP-based integrated alert system for the whole country. The all-India RSS feed lists current alerts with their text, category, issuing agency, publication time and a link to the full CAP XML message for each alert. On the day it was read the feed carried 99 weather alerts from the Central Water Commission (CWC) and regional centres of the India Meteorological Department; the portal also shows state-wise alerts, a map and a dashboard. The feed is free and available without registration, marked public domain, and each CAP file can be downloaded by its identifier. Caveats: the feed holds current alerts only, so an archive has to be built by polling it; alert texts are often in Hindi or regional languages; and alert areas must be read from each CAP file. Simulation uses: driving emergency response and service disruption scenarios from real warnings, measuring warning lead times, and linking alerts to exposed hospitals and shelters. Related records: the US National Weather Service CAP alerts (data-nws-cap-alerts), the German NINA warnings API (data-bbk-nina-warnings-api) and the WMO register of alerting authorities (data-wmo-register-of-alerting-authorities).
